author: Pallas, 1776
status: 나그네새 10만 마리 이상 · 겨울철새 수만 마리
habitat: 경작지 주변, 구릉, 소림, 낙엽활엽수림, 침엽수림, 혼효림
summary: 경작지 주변과 구릉, 성긴 숲, 낙엽활엽수림·침엽수림·혼효림에서 지내는 흔한 겨울철새로, 전국에서 볼 수 있다. 겨울에는 주로 풀씨를 먹고, 여름에는 곤충의 애벌레와 어른벌레를 먹는다. 한배에 알을 4~6개 낳는다. 국외에서는 캄차카, 일본, 중국 동부에 분포한다.

points.en: black head in summer, brown in winter

sexes.male: 머리꼭대기와 뺨의 색이 암컷보다 또렷하고 아랫면 줄무늬도 진하다.
sexes.female: 머리꼭대기와 뺨의 색이 탁하고 아랫면 줄무늬가 더 연하다.

art.subject: Rustic Bunting (Emberiza rustica), adult male in winter plumage, as seen on Korean field margins from November to March: crown brown with fine dark streaks, often raised into a short peak; broad whitish-buff supercilium; brown ear-coverts with a pale spot at the rear corner; whitish throat bordered by a dark malar stripe; nape rufous; mantle rufous-brown streaked black; rump rufous; underparts white with a band of rufous-chestnut spots across the breast and bold rufous streaks along the flanks; wings brown with two narrow whitish wing bars; tail dark brown with white outer feathers. Conical bill pink with a darker culmen; dark eye; pink legs.
art.pose: foraging on the ground, picking up grass seeds
art.scene: Korean winter: field margins and low hills at the edge of open mixed woodland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, breeding plumage (seen on spring passage, March–April), side view perched: black crown and ear-coverts, white supercilium and throat, rufous nape, rufous-chestnut breast band, rufous-streaked flanks, black-streaked rufous-brown upperparts, white belly

adult in winter plumage, side view on the ground: brown streaked crown with a short peak, whitish supercilium and throat, rufous-chestnut spotted breast band, rufous flank streaks on greyish-white underparts, white outer tail feathers
adult female, head detail in side view: brown crown and ear-coverts (never black), buffish-white supercilium and throat, dark malar stripe, pale spot at the rear of the ear-coverts
art.build: Small bunting, 15cm, sparrow-sized but slimmer and longer-tailed, often crouching while feeding on the ground in small flocks. The crown feathers are frequently raised into a short crest, giving a peaked head. Bill conical and pointed, much shorter than the head. Legs short, pink. At rest the wingtips reach just past the base of the tail. Tail medium length, notched, with white outer feathers that flash in flight.
avoid: Do not paint the breast band grey or black; it is rufous-chestnut.
Do not paint yellow on the face or throat — that is Yellow-throated Bunting.
Do not paint a black head on winter birds; it is brown outside the breeding season.
Do not streak the whole breast dark; the markings are rufous, in a breast band and along the flanks.
